name: MapIt
tagline: Match postcodes and geographical points to administrative areas
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on UK postcode and boundary data accuracy
academic_citations: Civic Tech and the Reinvention of Democracy (2016) - references MapIt as foundational civic data infrastructure
awards: Recognized as key civic infrastructure by UK Government Digital Service

policy_outcomes.description: UK Government uses MapIt to match users with their local council for services like recycling or allotment applications

outcome_methodology: Service integration tracking - MapIt API calls from government services
published_performance_metrics: API uptime and response time metrics available on mySociety documentation
documented_limitations: Dependent on Ordnance Survey data licensing
failure_modes: Data lag when local government reorganizations occur
curation_criteria: mySociety project governance - open source contributions welcome with code review process
contributor_governance: Community contributions via GitHub pull requests, reviewed by mySociety team
community_ownership: Community-driven development with open source contributions, but owned and maintained by mySociety

government_partnerships.nature: Service integration for local council matching
